verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Super Electric Strike — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Super Electric Strike as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 300 Ki, with a wide-area and high-power Ki Blast characteristic.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material lists Expert Mission 11 — The Devil Born from the Dragon Balls as the unlock route. Older Xenoverse documentation records a different Parallel Quest route; that historical record is retained in sources without replacing the current Xenoverse 2 route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted because the available evidence establishes an Expert Mission acquisition route but does not provide qualifying explicit Ultimate Finish evidence.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Super Electric Strike is kept distinct from DUAL Super Electric Strike and other Android 17 Ki Blast attacks.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.
